@01A *, ,DAM PA'I CHOS MNGON PA'I MDZOD KYI RNAM PAR BSHAD PA
THAR LAM GSAL BYED CES BYA BA BZHUGS SO, ,

@01B [DD] *, ,RJE BTZUN DAM PA THUGS RJE CHEN PO DANG LDAN PA
RNAMS KYI [DD] ZHABS LA GUS PAS PHYAG 'TSAL LO, ,BYI RU'I
MDANGS DANG 'DRES PA'I GSER [DD]

BZANG MDOG ,MDOG LEGS SHES BYA MA LUS LHANG NGER MKHYEN,
,MKHYEN RAB DBANG PHYUG 'JAM DBYANGS 'GRO BA'I SKYABS, ,SKYABS
MCHOG KHYED KYIS RAB

'BYAMS SHES RAB STZOL, ,RNAM BKRA'I GZUGS LA MIG GIS LTA BA
BZHIN, RNAM MANG RGYAL BA'I GSUNG RAB MTHA' DAG LA, ,RNAM DAG
MKHYEN PA THOGS PA MED

'JUG PA, ,THOGS MED SKU MCHED ZHABS LA PHYAG 'TSAL LO, ,RGYAL
BA THAMS CAD GCIG BSDUS RDO RJE 'CHANG, ,GDUL BYA'I DON DU BSHES
GNYEN TSUL 'DZIN PA,,

BLO BZANG GRAGS PA'I DPAL ZHES SA GSUM GYI, ,SKYE DGU'I 'DREN
PA MCHOG LA PHYAG 'TSAL LO, ,LEGS BSHAD DAR BA'I MKHYEN PA
MKHA' LTAR YANGS, ,'GRO

@02A [DD] *, ,LA MA LTAR BRTZE BA RGYUN DU GOMS, ,THUB BSTAN
RIN CHEN RGYAS PA'I 'PHRIN LAS CAN, ,RGYAL TSAB CHOS RJE'I
ZHABS LA PHYAG 'TSAL LO, ,DON GNYIS SGRUB LA RAB DKAR [DD]

DGE TSOGS KUN, ,RNAM DAG SMON PA'I 'DUN PA BTANG TZAM GYIS,
,'PHRIN LAS LHUN GYIS GRUB PA'I DPAL MNGA' BA'I, ,BDAG GI

YOD DAM ZHE NA, SRID

SKABS LNGA, BTZAS BA'I GNAS

SKABS LNGA STE BCU GCIG MYONG BAR NGES MA NGES GNYIS GNYIS TE
'PHEN PA RNAM PA NYI SHU RTZA GNYIS YOD LA, NGES PA BCU GCIG NI
MTHONG CHOS LA 'BRAS BU CAN GYI LAS BYED PA YIN TE, DE NI LAS
SOG PA'I GNAS SKABS KYI PHUNG BO DANG

@124B RNAM SMIN MYONG BA'I GNAS SKABS KYI PHUNG PO GNYIS 'PHEN

PA'I PHYIR, GNYIS PA NI, RNAM SMIN MYONG NGES KYI LAS DE GANG
ZHEN, MYON MONGS PA

DANG RAB TU DANG BA SHUGS DRAG BO DANG YON TAN GYI ZHING DKON
MCHOG LA BRTEN PA DANG, RGYUN CHAGS SU BYAS PA GANG ZHIG YIN PA
DANG, BSOD NAMS KYI BLOS KYANG RUNG BA PHA MA GSOD PA'I LAS GANG
YIN PA DE RNAM SMIN

MYONG BAR NGES PA'O, ,DE NI MTHONG CHOS 'BRAS BU YIN, ,ZHES
BSHAD NA DE GANG ZHE NA, MTHONG CHOS 'BRAS BU CAN GYI LAS ZHING
DANG BSAM BA'I KHYAD PAR LAS 'GYUR PA YIN TE, ZHING GI KHYAD PAR
LAS MTHONG CHOS 'BRAS BU CAN

GYI LAS SU 'GYUR PA NI, SDON BDAG CAG GI STON PA DGE SLONG SDE
SNOD GSUM PAR GYUR PA NA, DGE 'DUN GYIS RTZOD PA 'PHEL BAR BYAS
PA DGE SLOD SDE SLO
